beads_commands.name: complete acceptance criteria
beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0203: Define the observation envelope and idempotency contract

argv: Accepted the V1 committed-observation contract with exact coding scope, deterministic crash-safe idempotency, inert-or-explicit extension handling, and provider-effect semantics that do not equate observations with memory records.

Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-observation-contract.json and its strict schema define immutable post-settlement envelopes carrying profile/project/repository/worktree/branch/session scope, canonical source receipts, payload and extension digests, provenance, privacy, ordering, deadline, and cancellation. Unknown optional extensions round-trip as opaque inert data, unknown required extensions fail explicitly, and no extension can activate behavior or mutate authority. Observation IDs are never provider memory IDs; one observation may produce zero, one, or many opaque provider-local effects and stable memory references remain optional. Idempotency keys include provider/registration/scope/source revision/payload/extension identity, survive retries and restarts, and require persisted provider deduplication; same key/same canonical content is duplicate acknowledgement, while divergent content is conflict. Delivery is at least once, out-of-order tolerant, batch-bounded, receipt-backed, and mechanically non-influential in observer mode. The validator and mutation tests enforce every acceptance criterion and cross-check the accepted registry and handshake contracts.
